name: Lithium carbonate precipitation
notes: 2 LiCl + Na2CO3 -> Li2CO3 + 2 NaCl. Soda ash is imported in the first content slice; NaCl is routed to the chemical sector.

name: Chlor-alkali electrolysis
notes: 2 NaCl + 2 H2O -> 2 NaOH + Cl2 + H2. Requires electricity, brine conductivity and separated gas paths.

name: Hydrogen-chlorine acid synthesis
notes: H2 + Cl2 -> 2 HCl. Exothermic; recoverable low-grade heat is a cross-sector utility coproduct.

name: Lithium hydroxide causticisation
notes: Li2CO3 + Ca(OH)2 + 2 H2O -> 2 LiOH.H2O + CaCO3. Hot concentrated caustic service is a safety hazard.

name: Magnesium precipitation
notes: MgCl2 + 2 NaOH -> Mg(OH)2 + 2 NaCl. pH overshoot wastes caustic and contaminates the cake.
